nodes.description: The Handheld Mapper has no Safety view because it has no safety function: no E-stop, interlock, safety relay or monitored circuit in the connection data, the Design Tracker or the assembly instructions (HHM05801). Low-voltage USB-PD supply, no moving parts driven by it.

harnesses.name: CAN_2 · COMMS_01/08
harnesses.description:
Label before the harness map: CAN_2
Harness: AMR_COMMS_HNS_01 — CHS-000069 … CHS-000078 (10)
  CAN: CanW1 Orin->F travel, W7 F travel->F steer, W2 F steer->RR travel, W8 RR travel->RR steer, W3 RR steer->RL travel, W9 RL travel->RL steer, W6 RL steer->HMI CAN, W4 Orin->lift, W5 lift->CAN termination, W10 inverter->CAN/RS485
  wire CanW-4 · match high — Orin -> lift kit motor driver
  wire CanW-5 · match high — Lift driver -> CAN termination board
  Assembly instructions: AMR00313
Harness: AMR_COMMS_HNS_08_V1.0 — CHS-000003
  CAN + 24V to Tool DC interaction
  wire COMM · match high — CAN PCB (tool) -> Tool DC comm INT
  match high — set in the app (V4)
  Assembly instructions: AMR00313, AMR00317
── harness map ──
Drawn as one bus. The cable is a daisy chain - per assembly instruction AMR00313: Orin → Lift kit motor driver (CanW4) → CAN termination board (CanW5); the termination board feeds the Tool DC interaction socket (COMMS_08).

ControllerCompute → LiftDriver
Net: Comm_CAN_2
Type: Comm
Wire: not specified

LiftDriver → Can_Terminaiton_Board
Net: Comm_CAN_2
Type: Comm
Wire: not specified

Can_Terminaiton_Board → ToolDC_PowerComms_Interaction
Net: Comm_CAN_2
Type: Comm
Wire: not specified
